name: @ccdd/core
description: Artifact, Critic, relationship and tool definitions for CCDD

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-build.mjs && npm run build:core && npm run build:tools && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run build:ui && npm run build:project
scripts.build:ui: npm run typecheck:ui && vite build --config vite.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck:ui
scripts.test: npm run check:language && npm run build && node --test --test-reporter=tap --test-concurrency=4 dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.demo:prepare: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js prepare-demo
scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js run --demo --copy --wait
